eps.t: Night of the Lizard
eps.d: After a fraternity hazing, Spider-Man must battle an old friend.

eps.t: The Spider Slayer
eps.d: Spider-Man must battle a warrior consumed with honor.

eps.t: The Return of the Spider-Slayers
eps.d: Peter discovers his mentor has become the vengeful Lizard.

eps.t: Doctor Octopus: Armed and Dangerous
eps.d: Spider-Man is out to catch Talon, a female thief who is responsible for high-risk robberies in the city. Things get complicated when Spidey finds out that Talon is his best friend Harry's new girlfriend.

eps.t: The Menace of Mysterio
eps.d: A television station is taken hostage by ex-KGB agents.

eps.t: The Sting of the Scorpion
eps.d: An amateur inventor is determined to make Spider-Man her soul-mate.

eps.t: Kraven the Hunter
eps.d: Electro tries to convert Sally into pure energy.

eps.t: The Alien Costume: Part 1
eps.d: An assassin targets Peter after an attempt on the Mayor's life.

eps.t: The Alien Costume: Part 2
eps.d: Kingpin tricks Spider-Man into performing a high-profile robbery.

eps.t: The Alien Costume: Part 3
eps.d: Spider-Man battles Turbo Jet, a modern-day Robin Hood armed with a homemade propulsion system, who steals from the wealthy and gives to the poor. Spidey's life gets even harder as the public rallies around Turbo Jet – and against Spider-Man.

eps.t: The Hobgoblin: Part 1
eps.d: Peter's old rival, Flash Thompson, develops a super-intellect.

eps.t: The Hobgoblin: Part 2
eps.d: Spider-Man becomes the instrument of the Gaines Twins' revenge.

eps.t: Day of the Chameleon
eps.d: Spider-Man realizes he has been brainwashed.
